overview: Silent Dunes are the most unsettling part of The Grey.
details: With no air and no sound, the dunes shift silently. Resonance ghosts drift across the sands, remnants of ancient Akheva experiments.
hooks: A dune moves against gravity, revealing a silent cavern.
Resonance ghosts gather near a vacuum ridge.
A predator pack stalks travelers without sound.
A silent storm approaches from the barrens.
